jobs.title: AI & Product Owner - Product Discovery & Delivery
jobs.description:
**About Techdome**
------------------


Techdome is a product\-driven technology company building AI\-first platforms across Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, Enterprise Automation, and Payments. We build products that solve real business problems using modern technology, AI, and customer\-first thinking.
We're looking for professionals who thrive in fast\-paced environments, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to build products used by thousands of users.**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a **Technical Product Owner** who can take complete ownership of product features from discovery and requirement gathering to release planning and production rollout.
This role goes far beyond documentation. You'll collaborate closely with Founders, Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, QA, and Business teams to define product strategy, prioritize features, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.
If you're someone who enjoys understanding customer problems, working with engineering teams, and driving products from idea to launch, we'd love to meet you.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own product features from discovery through production release.
* Gather, analyze, and prioritize business, customer, and stakeholder requirements.
* Translate business needs into clear technical requirements for engineering teams.
* Create and maintain Product Backlogs, User Stories, Epics, Acceptance Criteria, BRDs, FRDs, and Functional Specifications.
* Lead Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews, and Release Planning.
* Define product roadmaps alongside business and engineering stakeholders.
* Collaborate with UX/UI Designers on workflows, wireframes, and user journeys.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops and requirement discussions.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), production releases, and post\-release validation.
* Analyze customer feedback, product usage, and business metrics to recommend product improvements.
* Work closely with Engineering, QA, Design, and Business teams throughout the SDLC.
* Leverage AI tools to improve requirement analysis, documentation, product discovery, and overall productivity.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* 3\+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, or Product Manager.
* Experience working on B2C digital products.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience owning products or major product features end\-to\-end.
* Strong expertise in:
	+ Product Backlog Management
	+ Sprint Planning \& Release Planning
	+ Product Roadmapping
	+ User Stories, Epics \& Acceptance Criteria
	+ BRDs, FRDs \& Functional Documentation
* Hands\-on experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar collaboration tools.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Comfortable working across multiple products simultaneously.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------


Experience in any of the following will be an added advantage:* REST APIs
* SQL
* System Design fundamentals
* Product Analytics
* AI Products
* LLMs
* RAG
* AI Agents
* Prompt Engineering
* Product Discovery
* Customer Journey Mapping
* Product Metrics \& Analytics

**AI\-First Product Development**
---------------------------------


At Techdome, AI is embedded into the way we build products.
We're looking for candidates who actively use AI to improve research, documentation, product thinking, requirement analysis, and execution.
Experience with tools such as:* Claude
* Cursor
* GitHub Copilot
* Gemini
* Perplexity
* Notion AI
* Windsurf

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role**
----------------------------------------------

* Thinks like a product owner, not just a documentation expert.
* Takes ownership from idea to production.
* Can confidently collaborate with technical and business stakeholders.
* Makes data\-driven product decisions.
* Focuses on customer outcomes instead of simply delivering features.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced, AI\-first product environment.

**Why Join Techdome?**
----------------------

* Build AI\-first products with real business impact.
* Work directly with founders and product leadership.
* Own product decisions from concept to launch.
* Collaborate with high\-performing engineering and design teams.
* Exposure to Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, Enterprise Automation, and Payments.
* Opportunity to work on multiple innovative products and accelerate your career growth.

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* AI Interview (JustInterview.ai)
* Technical \& Functional Discussion
* Leadership Discussion

From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. **Position:** Social Media Manager

About Vaarahi Eco Industries

Vaarahi Eco Industries is committed to promoting sustainable living through innovative, eco\-friendly products and awareness campaigns. Our mission is to encourage environmentally responsible practices through impactful products, community engagement, and digital outreach.

Position Overview

We are looking for a creative, result\-oriented, and highly motivated **Social Media Manager** to strengthen our digital presence through **organic content and community engagement**.

The ideal candidate should be passionate about storytelling, social media growth, influencer collaborations, and sustainability. This role focuses on building brand awareness through **organic reach rather than paid advertising**.

* Manage and maintain the company's Instagram and Facebook accounts.
* Plan, create, schedule, and publish daily content.
* Design and publish engaging posts, stories, reels, and short\-form videos.
* Develop content calendars aligned with brand campaigns and seasonal events.

Content Creation

* Create high\-quality Instagram reels to improve organic reach.
* Write compelling captions, hashtags, and content descriptions.
* Identify trending topics, audio, and content formats.
* Ensure all content reflects the company's brand identity and sustainability values.

Website and Blog Management

* Write, edit, and publish website blogs.
* Update website content regularly.
* Optimize blog content for search engines (SEO).

Influencer Outreach and Collaborations

* Identify and connect with influencers, creators, environmental advocates, celebrities, and community leaders.
* Develop collaboration opportunities to increase brand visibility.
* Manage communication, partnerships, and influencer relationships.
* Track collaboration performance and engagement.

Community Engagement

* Respond to comments, messages, and customer inquiries.
* Build an active online community.
* Increase follower engagement through organic interactions.

Analytics and Reporting

* Monitor social media performance.
* Track follower growth, engagement, reach, and content performance.
* Submit regular performance reports and recommendations.

Required Skills

* Experience managing Instagram and Facebook business accounts.
* Strong knowledge of Instagram Reels and organic growth strategies.

* Previous experience in social media management.

With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real\-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud\-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose\-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit 
 **www.sonicwall.com**

 **Twitter** 
 , 
 **LinkedIn** 
 , 
 **Facebook** 
  and 
 **Instagram** 
 .
 


 About Cloud Secure Edge
 
 Cloud Secure Edge (CSE) is SonicWall’s cloud\-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) platform, providing enterprise\-grade Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), VPN\-as\-a\-Service, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) capabilities. CSE enables organizations to enforce least\-privilege access policies across managed and unmanaged devices, continuously verifying user identity, device posture, and contextual signals before granting access to private applications, SaaS resources, and internet destinations. This is a high\-growth, strategically critical product line at the center of SonicWall’s SASE transformation.
 


 The Role
 
 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape and drive SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge. In this role, you will serve as the connective tissue between engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success—translating market needs and customer insights into product direction. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp commercial instinct, influencing the platform’s evolution to deliver measurable security outcomes for SonicWall customers and partners.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy \& Roadmap
 * Influence and help define the Cloud Secure Edge product vision and strategy; own the execution of the multi\-quarter roadmap aligned with SonicWall’s SASE and Zero Trust go\-to\-market objectives.
* Prioritize features and capabilities based on customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and engineering feasibility.
* Develop and present business cases for new investments to executive leadership, including TAM analysis, win/loss data, and projected impact on ARR.


 Technical Product Ownership
 * Partner closely with engineering leadership to define requirements, write detailed specifications, and make informed trade\-off decisions on scope, architecture, and delivery timelines.
* Drive integration strategy across SonicWall’s security portfolio, including firewalls, endpoint agents, and threat intelligence services.
* Ensure extensibility for MSP automation workflows and third\-party integrations (SIEM, SOAR, IdP).
* Evaluate and influence platform architecture decisions related to multi\-tenancy, scalability, and cloud\-native deployment models.


 Zero Trust \& SASE Domain Leadership
 * Serve as the internal subject matter expert on ZTNA, SSE, and SASE frameworks, educating cross\-functional teams and informing competitive positioning.
* Monitor and analyze the competitive landscape (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma, Cloudflare, Netskope) to identify differentiation opportunities and parity gaps.
* Translate regulatory and compliance trends (NIST Zero Trust Architecture, CISA guidelines) into actionable product requirements.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Go\-to\-Market
 * Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop positioning, messaging, competitive battle cards, and sales enablement content.
* Work directly with strategic customers and MSP partners to validate product direction, conduct design\-partner programs, and gather feedback.
* Support sales engineering teams with technical deep\-dives, RFP responses, and proof\-of\-concept engagements.
* Define and track product success metrics including adoption, activation, retention, NPS, and ARR contribution.


 Required Qualifications
 * 5\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on network security, cloud security, or identity/access management products.
* Deep working knowledge of ZTNA, SASE, SSE, SWG, CASB, and/or VPN technologies and their underlying architectures.
* Proven track record of shipping cloud\-native or SaaS products at scale, with experience managing multi\-tenant platforms.
* Strong technical fluency: ability to engage with engineering teams on API design, microservices architecture, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience working with channel and MSP partner ecosystems in the cybersecurity space.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to C\-level stakeholders..


 Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and their integration patterns with ZTNA platforms.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or relevant cloud/security credentials.
* Experience with agile product development methodologies and tools (Jira, Aha!, Productboard).
* Background in data\-driven product management with proficiency in analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo).
* AI fluency and demonstrated ability to prototype with AI tools: comfortable leveraging LLMs, copilots, and generative AI to accelerate research, ideation, spec writing, and rapid prototyping of product concepts.

This hybrid role seeks a Product Test Specialist with five to seven years of experience in testing complex health care payer and provider solutions built on Facets and TriZetto Elements platforms. The specialist will validate enrollment benefits claims provider and CAE configurations to ensure accurate and reliable administration for payer and provider clients and support high quality member outcomes.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Perform end to end testing of Facets enrollment benefit configuration claims provider and CAE modules to ensure that payer and provider processes function accurately and consistently across releases.
  
Design detailed test scenarios and test cases based on business requirements for enrollment benefits claims and provider functions to confirm that each configuration behaves as expected for diverse member and provider segments.
  
Execute functional regression and integration tests on Facets and TriZetto Elements solutions to detect defects early and reduce production incidents for payer and provider customers.
  
Coordinate closely with business analysts and configuration teams to interpret complex payer and provider rules and translate them into clear test coverage for enrollment and benefits workflows.

Use CAE tools to analyze configuration effectiveness and identify test gaps so that enrollment and benefit changes are accurately reflected in member and provider transactions.

Collaborate in a hybrid work model by joining virtual and in office sessions with cross functional teams to clarify requirements and align on test scope for each release.
  
Contribute to continuous improvement by suggesting enhancements to test coverage reusable test assets and automation candidates that increase efficiency and reduce cycle time.
  
Support user acceptance testing by guiding business stakeholders through test scenarios for payer and provider functions and by addressing questions on configuration behavior.

Prepare clear test summary reports and metrics that highlight risk areas configuration gaps and quality trends so that stakeholders can make informed release decisions.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Demonstrate five to seven years of focused experience in testing Facets modules including enrollment benefit configuration claims provider and CAE in large payer environments.
  
Apply deep hands on expertise in TriZetto Elements and Facets configuration testing to validate complex benefit designs and network structures for payer and provider clients.
  
Exhibit strong understanding of health care payer and provider domains including enrollment life cycle benefit administration provider network management and claims adjudication concepts.

Adapt quickly to evolving payer regulations product changes and system upgrades while maintaining high quality standards in all test activities for day shift operations.

jobs.description:
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent, technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to partner with a local in\-person engineering team in Bengaluru focused on music distribution. Distribution is the vital link between music creation and a fan’s headphones, ensuring our music reaches platforms like Spotify and YouTube globally while protecting the complex rights that ensure our artists get paid. You will be a "user\-first" thinker who is responsible for a portfolio of features and products, navigating the high\-stakes world of global rights, supply chain automation, and high\-scale digital delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Continuous Discovery: Build deep empathy for our labels, operations teams, and global partners by maintaining a constant dialogue with them. Uncover their underlying pain points, ensuring that every solution we build truly solves their problems and makes their daily workflows more seamless.
* Strategy \& Roadmap: Define and communicate the long\-term vision and roadmap for your products, ensuring they align with WMG’s broader tech strategy.
* Product Trio Collaboration: Work in a "Product Trio" alongside Engineering and Design to solve complex problems, resolving trade\-offs and tackling risks.
* Execution \& Ownership: Serve as the primary author of PRDs and the "executor\-in\-chief" for your projects, driving development from ideation through technical delivery.
* Launch \& Impact: Develop comprehensive go\-to\-market strategies, including product positioning, internal messaging, and launch plans. You don't just "ship" code; you ensure the organization is ready to adopt it to achieve maximum impact.
* Analytical Optimization: Continuously monitor product performance metrics, user feedback, and market trends. Use this data to make informed prioritization decisions, identify areas for improvement, and manage technical debt to optimize the product over its entire lifecycle.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to the music business or other digital media.
* Technical \& Business Savvy: You can discuss system architecture with engineers and business constraints with executives, mitigating Value, Usability, Feasibility, and Business Viability risks upfront.
* A Master Storyteller: You own the "Why" and can easily adjust your communication style for different audiences, from developers to more senior stakeholders.
* Biased to Action: You have a proven ability to unstick a team, make difficult prioritization decisions, and navigate the ambiguity of a global business.
* Humble Leader: You have strong opinions, held weakly; you are quick to share credit with your team and accept responsibility when things don’t go as planned.
* Mission\-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**About The Role**
 HackerRank's goal is straightforward: to give companies a dependable way to evaluate whether a candidate can do the job. The previous model, which relied on test cases and code correctness, is becoming less reliable as candidates use AI assistants and produce work that requires deeper scrutiny.
   

  

 The Evaluation team is rebuilding the underlying scoring system. This involves defining the new evaluation rubrics, determining how our models apply them consistently across thousands of candidates, working with enterprise clients to define good performance, and ensuring our methodology is fair and defensible.
   

  

 Evaluation's trustworthiness is fundamental to HackerRank's business and its products. We are looking to hire a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to own this crucial charter.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the evaluation product roadmap: what gets built, in what order, and why, with a clear point of view on what the product needs to become over the next 12 to 18 months.
* Define what "good evaluation" means in product terms: the rubrics, scoring dimensions, bias safeguards, and consistency checks that enterprise customers will stake hiring decisions on.
* Work directly with ML engineers and AI researchers to translate methodology into shipped product. You are the connective tissue between research clarity and engineering execution.
* Talk to enterprise customers regularly. Understand how Goldman Sachs defines a strong candidate differently from how a startup does, and make sure the product can serve both.
* Build the feedback loops that let the evaluation system improve: how we capture when customers disagree with a score, what signals we surface to the ML team, and how we close the loop.
* Define and own the metrics that tell us whether evaluation quality is actually improving, not just whether we shipped something.


**Who You Are**
* You have 5 or more years of product experience, with meaningful time in a B2B or enterprise context where your work had to be defensible to sophisticated customers.
* You think rigorously about if the measures actually map to the outcomes. A PM who cannot tell the difference between a good metric and a vanity metric will not survive this role.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity in the problem definition. The answer to "what does good evaluation look like" does not exist yet. You need to want to find it, not wait for someone to hand it to you.
* You can hold your own in a technical conversation with ML engineers without needing to code. You understand enough about model behavior, evaluation pipelines, and data feedback loops to ask sharp questions.
* You communicate with precision. Crisp PRDs, sharp debate in design reviews, clear framing to customers and leadership. You do not hide behind vague language when the problem is hard.


**Even better if you have**
* Prior experience in assessment, ed\-tech, talent tech, or any domain where you had to build products around subjective or qualitative evaluation.
* Exposure to fairness, bias, or compliance considerations in a product context.
* Experience building or working closely with ML\-powered scoring or ranking systems.
* Track record of defining new product categories rather than iterating on established ones.


**You will thrive if you**
* Believe the evaluation problem is one of the most interesting unsolved problems in enterprise software right now.
* You want to own a roadmap that is genuinely consequential, not increment on features that already exist.
* Are the kind of PM who would rather have a sharp conversation about what we should not build than ship something that does not hold up. You are not scared of technical depth. You lean into it.


**Want to learn more about HackerRank?** 
 Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.
   

  

 HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Linkedin \| X \| Blog \| Instagram \| Life@HackerRank
   

  

**Notice To Prospective HackerRank Job Applicants**
* Our Recruiters use @hackerrank.com email addresses.
* We never ask for payment or credit check information to apply, interview, or work here.

**About Bluevine**
 Bluevine is the largest small business banking platform in the U.S., redefining how entrepreneurs manage their money. We create modern financial solutions, from checking and lending to payments and beyond, designed to help small business owners grow, thrive, and take control of their financial future. Our best\-in\-class technology, advanced security, and deep understanding of the small business community give our customers the confidence to focus on what they do best.
   

  

 Since 2013, we’ve supported more than 750,000 small businesses nationwide. Backed by leading investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Menlo Ventures, 83North, and Citi Ventures, our 500\+ person global team shares one mission: to give small businesses the financial tools they need to succeed.
   

  

 We’re innovators driven by big ideas, collaboration, and real impact. Here, you’ll have the freedom to take ownership, grow your career, and make a difference for small business owners across America. Ready to shape what’s next?
   

  

***This is a hybrid role* 
*.***
 At Bluevine, we pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, which we believe is best maintained through in\-person interactions and a vibrant office environment. All of our offices have reopened in accordance with local guidelines, and are following a hybrid model. In\-office days will be determined by location and discipline.
   

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
 Bluevine is looking for an experienced Product Manager to own and drive key lending and credit initiatives across our business financing products. This person will define and execute the roadmap for lending acquisition, eligibility, underwriting, offer generation, lender network integrations, customer\-facing financing experiences, and internal operational workflows that support credit decisioning and servicing.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Risk, Data, Engineering, Sales, Operations, Compliance, and external lending partners. The ideal candidate is comfortable working through complex credit and operational logic, translating business and risk requirements into scalable product experiences, and improving how small businesses discover, qualify for, accept, and manage financing through Bluevine.
   

  

 The platform and systems in this domain are mission\-critical: they determine which customers are eligible for financing, how offers are generated and displayed, how applications move through underwriting, how partner lenders receive data, and how internal teams manage exceptions, statuses, communications, and follow\-up workflows.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**
* Own and drive the product roadmap for lending and credit experiences across the lending business unit — aligning features and initiatives to company strategy, OKRs, and KPIs through close collaboration with leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Conduct business discovery and gather requirements from a broad set of internal stakeholders, including risk, back\-office operations, accounting, finance, and legal compliance teams
* Define detailed technical specifications for new features and projects, outlining business requirements, acceptance criteria, and system design considerations — serving as a precise guide for engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle
* Partner closely with R\&D and QA teams through sprint planning and execution, conducting UAT before production deployments and driving issues and bugs to resolution
* Monitor and maintain mission\-critical systems across payments, accounting, and capital markets — ensuring data accuracy, integrating with banks and vendors, and enhancing internal operational tools for efficiency and scalability
* Identify the business case for new products and enhancements through data analysis, SQL\-based querying, customer feedback, and stakeholder input — prioritizing work for highest business impact
* Facilitate smooth communication between R\&D teams and business stakeholders, providing regular project updates, managing expectations, and proactively identifying and mitigating risks
* Conduct demo sessions for new features prior to launch and develop training materials and reports for stakeholders and partners


**WHAT WE LOOK FOR:**
* 5\+ years experience as a Product Manager in a fast\-paced technology company
* Fintech lending experience is a plus but not mandatory.
* A self\-starter with a bias to action who is able to move projects forward and lead a cross\-functional team towards product solution
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with the ability to interact with a diverse group of technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Advanced analytical skills, including experience with data analysis and SQL
* Experience managing complex projects with limited resources and competing priorities
* Experience with using AI tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT and Claude for research, automation and prototyping.
* B.A. or B.S. in physics, computer science, engineering, or related field
* Previous work experience in a technical role is a plus
* Masters, PhD, or MBA will be considered when evaluating work experience


**Benefits \& Perks**
* Excellent group health coverage and life insurance
* Stock options
* Meal allowance
* Transportation assistance (terms and conditions apply)
* Generous paid time off plan, Holidays
* Company\-sponsored mental health benefits
* Financial advisory services for both short\- and long\-term goals
* Learning and development opportunities to support career growth
* Community\-based volunteering opportunities

jobs.title: Incident Response Engineer ||
jobs.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.


By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.


Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

* Take end\-to\-end ownership of production incidents from **detection, logging, triage, impact assessment, prioritization, escalation, investigation, mitigation, resolution, recovery, and closure**.
* Act as the primary point of contact and single point of accountability for assigned incidents.
* Lead **P1/P2 and Sev0/Sev1 major incidents**, establish incident bridges/war rooms, and ensure structured coordination across Engineering, SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure, Cloud, Database, Network, Product, Support, and other relevant teams.
* Perform incident triage and determine the appropriate severity based on customer, business, and platform impact.
* Ensure the right technical owners and subject\-matter experts are engaged through the defined escalation matrix.
* Drive incidents with clear ownership, timelines, action items, escalation paths, and next steps until service restoration.
* Analyze application failures, service degradation, infrastructure issues, API failures, database issues, distributed\-system problems, cloud incidents, and other production issues.
* Review application logs, monitoring dashboards, alerts, service metrics, and system dependencies to support incident investigation.
* Develop a good understanding of application architecture, APIs, microservices, databases, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and service dependencies to effectively drive technical discussions.
* Coordinate with technical teams to identify the root cause, contributing factors, mitigation, and permanent corrective actions.
* Provide timely, accurate, and structured communication to technical teams, business stakeholders, leadership, and customers as required.
* Communicate incident impact, investigation progress, mitigation status, recovery updates, and next steps clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure communication follows defined templates, frequency, SLA, and escalation standards.
* Drive **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** and **Post\-Incident Reviews (PIRs)** for major incidents and ensure corrective and preventive actions are assigned, tracked, and closed.
* Analyze recurring incidents and work with Problem Management and Engineering teams to eliminate repeat issues and improve service reliability.
* Monitor production systems, service health dashboards, alerts, and operational tools to proactively identify customer\-impacting issues.
* Work with Monitoring, SRE, and Engineering teams to improve alert quality, thresholds, detection coverage, dashboards, and early\-warning mechanisms.
* Identify monitoring gaps and recommend new alerts, dashboards, automation, correlation, and auto\-remediation opportunities.
* Review incident and alert trends to identify opportunities for **alert reduction, tuning, proactive detection, and operational automation**.
* Follow ITIL/ITSM\-aligned **Incident, Major Incident, Problem, and Change Management** processes.
* Coordinate with Change and Release Management teams to identify and minimize production risks associated with releases, maintenance, and infrastructure changes.
* Support service transition activities and ensure operational readiness before services are moved into production.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve incident management **SOPs, runbooks, escalation matrices, response procedures, communication templates, and operational documentation**.
* Track operational metrics including **MTTD, MTTA, MTTR, response time, escalation adherence, incident SLA, RCA SLA, customer impact, and repeat incident trends**.
* Prepare incident reports, operational dashboards, management summaries, and trend analysis to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure effective shift handovers and continuity of ongoing incidents in a **24×7 global operations model**.
* Coordinate resources during critical incidents, assign tasks, track action items, and ensure the appropriate teams are engaged at the right time.
* Support junior Incident Managers and team members by providing guidance on incident handling, escalation, communication, and operational processes.
* Coordinate with external vendors and technology partners during incidents involving third\-party services and ensure timely updates, mitigation, RCA, and accountability.
* Identify opportunities to improve **service reliability, incident response, monitoring, automation, operational efficiency, and customer experience**.
* **Requirements**
* **3\+** **years of experience** in Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Production Support, Technical Operations, NOC, SRE, Application Support, or IT Service Management.
* Hands\-on experience managing **critical production incidents such as P1/P2, Sev0/Sev1, or equivalent severity incidents**.
* Strong understanding of **Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, ITIL, and ITSM processes**.
* Experience working in **SaaS, Cloud, Enterprise Software, or large\-scale production environments**.
* Good understanding of **application architecture, service dependencies, APIs, microservices, databases, distributed systems, and cloud technologies**.

**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

**What role you will play in our team**
---------------------------------------

This role works with IT, data engineering, business analysts, and process owners to connect source system data, build data models, configure Celonis dashboards, and ensure accurate process insights. The position focuses on data integration, SQL logic, platform support, data validation, and technical enablement of business process mining use cases.  

Job location: Bangalore India

--------------------


'\- Prepare Data from various systems and developing the data model by using SQL script and building the prototype dashboard analysis in Process Mining tool  

* Explore and propose technical solutions based on Celonis capabilities, available data, and business needs.
* Work with different businesses and EMIT support team around the globe.
* Troubleshoot data refresh issues, transformation errors, dashboard discrepancies, and data quality concerns.

-------------

* 3–5 years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, ETL development, data foundation development, materialized views, or analytics platform support.

* Fundamental business process knowledge in supply chain, Order\-to\-Cash, procurement, finance, or shared services processes.
* Experience with SAP, Snowflake, SQL Server, Oracle, Power BI, Python, or other enterprise analytics tools.
* Self\-driven with the ability to learn new tools, apply learnings quickly, and work independently.

---------------------


Data Visualization
Data Modeling
Applied Software Engineering for Data
Data Integration
Data Management

Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**PRODUCT OWNER**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking experienced Product Owners to help deliver on our product objectives and roadmaps. Product Owners are responsible for delivering product outcomes and functionality that meet customer and user needs. They translate product vision and insights into prioritized features and user stories, developed by their agile team of 8–10 members.
   

  

 This role collaborates with Candescent clients and Product Managers to identify and prioritize requirements for enhancements to the Banking Platform. Product Owners also work with the Product Advisory Council, participating in user group discussions and presenting both strategic and tactical functionality. Additional responsibilities include release planning, product roadmap maintenance, and backlog grooming for assigned Candescent Banking Services initiatives.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Lead efforts to define specific functions, integration requirements, user experiences, and deployment strategies for delivery to both the company and market
* Develop, shape, and refine user stories, problem statements, and acceptance criteria to ensure efficient and effective team consumption
* Collaborate with the broader product organization to ensure integration across all Candescent Digital Banking Technology products
* Work closely with the development team to ensure that delivered products meet specified requirements and are delivered on time and within budget
* Drive understanding of the work to be completed by the development team, supporting effective sprint sequencing and incremental delivery
* Participate actively in scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, daily stand\-ups, and demos
* Maintain functional quality by setting and evaluating expectations and acceptance criteria
* Present and train internal customers on new platform features and services released in each version
* Prepare explanatory documentation for customers on existing and new platform functionality
* Document business requirements using the company's software development tools and methodology


**Product P\&L and Pricing**
* Collaborate with the Product Manager to manage product profitability and performance, ensuring alignment with short\- and long\-term product objectives and roadmaps


**Product Strategy, Vision, and Planning**
* Gather customer and user needs, along with market research, to inform the product vision and strategy created by the Product Manager
* Use the product vision and insights to define product features and prioritize the team’s backlog


**Customer Experience Research, Insights, And Execution**
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of customers and users through the development of insights, including personas, journey maps, and product charters


**Product Design and Development**
* Participate in PI (Program Increment) planning to prioritize the roadmap and inform team backlogs
* Write and prioritize user stories based on business needs, user requirements, and technical feasibility
* Continuously refine the product backlog by analyzing value versus effort
* Define acceptance criteria and validate that features and stories meet user quality standards
* Drive product development in collaboration with cross\-functional teams and engage stakeholders (e.g., PMs, other POs, functions) to manage dependencies and resolve issues


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience

* Strong understanding of complex business and technical problems
* Proven experience delivering software products through the definition, design, and release cycle
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies throughout the software development lifecycle
* Familiarity with industry standards such as PCI, WCAG, and FFIEC
* Strong leadership, project management, time management, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Deep understanding of user and business needs to create and prioritize user stories that deliver value
* Ability to prioritize based on business value, user impact, and technical feasibility

Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility.
